column1: # XML paired samples Usage002_03/04: nested close tags whose candidate names are prefix-related.
# Hand oracle per model, not a shared contract: Java MatchedTokenParser lists candidates from the
#   innermost transaction level outwards and caches the list per parser instance for the whole parse;
#   nested levels share one class-factory instance. The Rust adapter tries earlier names in source order.
# The java/rust difference is the open MatchedTokenParser history/cache-lifetime gap #852.

column5: java nested close tries ab (own level) before a; rust history tries a first
java depth-1 close reuses the list cached at depth 2: ab first
java depth-1 close reuses the list cached at depth 2: a first, > fails
rust history tries a before ab at depth 2
